text: 1.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 2.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 3.Academic transcript of high school 4.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 6 or above 5.Photocopy of valid passport or residence permit With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 6.Resume Written in Chinese or in English
